terms.definition: A living thing that eats other living things for energy.
terms.function: Moves energy up the food chain.
terms.whereItIs: Every animal that does not make its own food.
terms.whyItMatters: Consumers connect plants to the rest of life.

terms.definition: A consumer that eats only plants.
terms.function: Turns plant energy into animal energy.
terms.whyItMatters: They are the first animals in many food chains.

terms.definition: A consumer that eats only other animals.
terms.whyItMatters: They keep food chains in balance.

terms.definition: A consumer that eats both plants and animals.
terms.function: Takes energy from producers and consumers.
terms.whyItMatters: Flexible eaters that adapt to many habitats.
